nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf holding token balances, mutated by transferFrom, _mints and batchSend without SafeMath guards.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] controlling transferFrom spending rights.
Private owner address; privileged gate for delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress, and whitelist bypass in ensure.
tradeAddress storage slot settable by owner and used as a whitelist bypass in ensure.
_saleNum private counter limiting how many transfers an account may perform.
_minSale private minimum transfer amount enforced by condition.
_maxSale private maximum transfer amount enforced by condition.
_onSaleNum per-account transfer counter incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
canSale whitelist mapping granting unrestricted transfers in ensure.
totalSupply public supply variable set once in the constructor.
decimals constant (18) multiplied into mint, init and _mints amounts.
name public token name string set in constructor.
symbol public token symbol string set in constructor.
msg.sender caller address used in transfer, transferFrom, approve, delegate, _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and the constructor.
transfer(address,uint) payable entry point that forwards msg.sender into transferFrom.
ensure(address,address,uint) internal whitelist/bypass check calling pairFor and condition.
transferFrom(address,address,uint) payable value-moving function with unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic and sale-limit logic.
approve(address,uint) payable function writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition(address,uint) internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum limits.
delegate(address,bytes) owner-only function performing a delegatecall to an arbitrary address.
_mints(address,uint) arbitrary mint function restricted to owner or a hard-coded address; also whitelists spender in canSale.
init(uint,uint,uint) owner-only sale-limit configuration function.
batchSend(address[],uint) owner-only batch balance transfer with unchecked multiplication and subtractions.
setTradeAddress(address) owner-only setter for tradeAddress whitelist slot.
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure Uniswap pair address computation.
payable constructor minting entire supply to msg.sender and granting unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Unsafe delegatecall in delegate() to an arbitrary implementation address, allowing owner-triggered arbitrary code execution.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked balance subtraction (balanceOf[_from] -= _value / balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total) without SafeMath.
Unchecked balance addition balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend enabling overflow of the total amount.
Unsafe low-level address(token).call(data) inside SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn, an external call to a semi-trusted token.
_from address parameter of transferFrom.
_to address parameter of transferFrom.
_value amount parameter of transferFrom.
_from address parameter of ensure.
_to address parameter of ensure.
_value amount parameter of ensure.
_spender address parameter of approve.
_from address parameter of condition.
_value amount parameter of condition.
a target address parameter of delegate (delegatecall destination).
b calldata bytes parameter of delegate passed to delegatecall.
spender address parameter of _mints receiving the minted balance.
addedValue amount parameter of _mints.
saleNum parameter of init controlling _saleNum limit.
token parameter of init controlling _minSale limit.
maxToken parameter of init controlling _maxSale limit.
_tos address array parameter of batchSend.
_value amount paid to each recipient in batchSend.
addr parameter of setTradeAddress written to tradeAddress.
_name constructor parameter.
_symbol constructor parameter.
_supply constructor parameter used to compute totalSupply.
Loop index i in batchSend iteration.
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Local _to = _tos[i] recipient inside batchSend loop.
Local _UNI computed pair address in ensure compared against _from.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transferFrom derives spending rights from msg.sender when it is not _from and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] under caller control.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary delegatecall.
_mints gate compares msg.sender against owner or a hard-coded address before minting.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before moving balances.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before writing tradeAddress.
owner is assigned from msg.sender in the constructor and later compared with msg.sender for privilege checks.
transfer delegates all value movement to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom calls ensure, whose whitelist bypass determines whether the sale-limit checks apply.
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) to enforce sale limits for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure computes the Uniswap pair via pairFor to obtain the _UNI whitelist address.
transferFrom mutates allowance[_from][msg.sender] with an unchecked subtraction of _value.
The allowance decrement in transferFrom is an unchecked arithmetic operation without SafeMath.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with raw += / -= arithmetic.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom is an unchecked balance subtraction.
balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom is an unchecked balance addition.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] to record the sender's sale count.
ensure grants a free pass when canSale[_from] is true, bypassing all sale condition checks.
ensure returns true when _from or _to equals owner, bypassing the sale conditions.
ensure returns true when _from equals tradeAddress, an owner-controlled whitelist bypass.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] and compares it against _saleNum.
condition reads _saleNum to decide whether per-account sale caps apply.
condition reads _minSale to enforce a lower bound on transfer value.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce an upper bound on transfer value.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall supplied by the owner, an unrestricted unsafe operation.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue * 10**decimals, minting arbitrary tokens.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, permanently whitelisting an address from sale checks.
_mints multiplies addedValue by 10**decimals when assigning the balance.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
init writes _minSale from token scaled by decimals.
init writes _maxSale from maxToken scaled by decimals.
init scales the sale limits with 10**decimals.
batchSend subtracts from balanceOf[msg.sender] and adds balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with an unchecked multiplication that can overflow.
batchSend performs balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total without SafeMath.
batchSend performs balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the loop without SafeMath.
setTradeAddress writes an arbitrary owner-supplied address into the tradeAddress whitelist bypass slot.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing all privileged access for the deployer.
Constructor mints the whole totalSupply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants allowance[msg.sender][UNI router] = uint(-1), an unlimited ERC20 approval.
Constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
Constructor scales the supply using 10**decimals.
SafeERC20 performs a low-level external call to a token contract that can reenter value-moving logic such as transferFrom before state finalization.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a direct parameter of transferFrom and only meaningful within that function's dataflow.
_to is a direct parameter of transferFrom used only for balance crediting.
_value is a direct parameter of transferFrom consumed by the unchecked arithmetic.
_from is a direct parameter of ensure used in the whitelist bypass checks.
_to is a direct parameter of ensure compared against owner.
_value is forwarded from ensure into condition.
_spender is the direct parameter of approve indexing the allowance mapping.
_from is a direct parameter of condition used to index _onSaleNum.
_value is a direct parameter of condition checked against _minSale/_maxSale.
a is the target address of the delegatecall performed by delegate.
b is the calldata bytes passed directly into the delegatecall.
spender is the direct parameter whose balance and canSale flag are set by _mints.
addedValue is the direct parameter used to compute the minted balance.
saleNum is a direct parameter of init written to _saleNum.
token is a direct parameter of init written to _minSale.
maxToken is a direct parameter of init written to _maxSale.
_tos is the direct recipient array parameter iterated by batchSend.
_value is the multiplicand of the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation.
addr is the direct parameter written into tradeAddress.
_name is a direct constructor parameter assigned to the name state variable.
_symbol is a direct constructor parameter assigned to the symbol state variable.
_supply is the direct constructor parameter used to compute totalSupply.
i is the loop counter local of batchSend and has no meaning outside that loop.
total is the local result of the unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length.
_to is the per-iteration recipient local of the batchSend loop.
_UNI is the computed pair address local compared against _from inside ensure.
